incidents.title: Read-heavy feed
incidents.brief: An app is serving a personalized feed with 95% reads and a single primary database becomes saturated.
incidents.constraint: Almost all traffic is read-only and writes are relatively small.
incidents.question: What is the most direct fix?

choices.label: Read replicas
choices.resultBody: Add read replicas and send read traffic to them.

choices.label: More app servers
choices.resultBody: Reads are still landing on the write node.

choices.label: Stop writes
choices.resultBody: Turn off write traffic

hints: Writes can stay on one primary.
